latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Video Maker Free Browser.

- Create and export AI-generated videos online by uploading video clips or images (MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG).
- No installation required; works fully in the browser.
- Supports natural language instructions to arrange clips, add music/text, and generate 1080p MP4 output.
- Built-in credits system with free starter token; supports 100 free credits for 7 days.
- Fast cloud-based rendering pipeline; exports typically ready in 1–2 minutes.
- Simple workflows for quick edits, batch processing, and iterative refinement.
